job_description: We are looking for a machine learning engineer to design, train and deploy predictive models. Required skills: Python, scikit-learn, TensorFlow or PyTorch, feature engineering, model evaluation and deployment. Experience with data analysis is a plus.

Seeking an NLP engineer to build language understanding systems such as text classification, semantic search and chatbots. Experience with transformer models, Hugging Face, embeddings and Python is required.
Looking for a web developer to create responsive user interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React. Experience integrating REST APIs and working with Git in an agile team is required.
The data analyst will collect and analyse business data, build dashboards and prepare reports for stakeholders. Skills needed: SQL, Excel, Power BI or Tableau, and strong communication.
Responsible for CI/CD pipelines, containerisation and cloud infrastructure. Must know AWS, Docker, Kubernetes and infrastructure as code tools.
